title: The merchant’s wake

branches.condition: Wayfarer completes its commercial contract and Spear intercepts a patrol
branches.consequence: The expedition finds the Sorenne patrol. A capable force fights and sustains its conditioning, at a further cost to civilian life. A force too weakened to fight is disabled instead.

branches.condition: No commercial contract completes and Spear intercepts a patrol
branches.consequence: The patrol is not found. The expedition disrupts civilian traffic without sustaining the cohort through combat. Council cargo does not substitute for the commercial voyage.

branches.condition: Spear does not intercept a patrol
branches.consequence: These interception consequences do not occur. An attack on the anchorage and other operations have their own consequences.

guidance: The Guild can change its vessel assignment before the faction bell. Security can choose an attack instead of an interception if Spear was offered and troop transport is available.
